description: Source code for Android's atrace utility, handling kernel and user-space tracing, including configuration, starting/stopping traces, and interfacing with HAL and sysfs.

classes.name: TracingCategory
classes.description: Defines a tracing category with name, description, tags, and associated sysfs files.

classes.name: TracingVendorFileCategory
classes.description: Represents a vendor-specific tracing category with enable paths.

classes.name: TracingVendorHalCategory
classes.description: Represents a vendor HAL tracing category with name, description, and enabled state.

methods.name: findTraceFiles
methods.description: Detects the trace filesystem directory (debugfs or tracefs).

methods.name: initVendorCategoriesFromFile
methods.description: Initializes vendor categories from a configuration file.

methods.name: initVendorCategoriesFromHal
methods.description: Initializes vendor categories via the atrace HAL service.

methods.name: initVendorCategories
methods.description: Chooses between file-based or HAL-based vendor category initialization.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating trace setup, execution, and cleanup based on command-line arguments.
